March 25

On the Union

By Ben Jonson (1572–1637)

The Union of Scotland and England by act of King James I of England and VI of Scotland, March 25, 1603.
W
HEN
 was there contract better driven by Fate,
Or celebrated with more truth of state?
The world the temple was, the priest a king,
The spoused pair two realms, the sea the ring.
